1168-1651-5921-6756-8344.easyPrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-5921-6756-8344.notablePrerequisites:
Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-5921-6756-8344.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3263-5414-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-5414-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-5414-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

512-2085-3990.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
512-2085-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kelpie Guide and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2085-3990.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Incubation Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

141-1893-2034.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-2034.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-5421-7824.description:
Activate Redcap Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Redcap Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Redcap Thief.
Resolve the Redcap Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1263-4871-6797-6887.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

101-4377-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Vampire Charmseeker
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

149-3286-4831.description:
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting Cacophodon.
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.
Cacophodon triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to itself.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

877-3122-6967.description:
Cast Undercover Operative by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Undercover Operative triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Undercover Operative.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-3899-6965.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

803-2366-5411-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-5411-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-4211-6968.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-4053-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-4053-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

2866-3518-4779-4986.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4616-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4050-4616-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2842-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

60-6790.manaNeeded: {U/R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
60-6790.easyPrerequisites: You have an additional instant or sorcery card in hand with mana value 4 or less.
60-6790.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery with mana value 4 or less by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pyromancer's Goggles by tapping it, adding {R}.
Cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Pyromancer's Goggles triggers, copying Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Resolve the copy of Expansion, creating a copy of Expansion targeting the original Expansion.
Repeat step 5.

1358-2073-4050--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the mana value 1 artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sydri's first ability by paying {U}, causing the artifact to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact, adding {U}.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more charge counters on it

198-3887-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {B} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +5/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Lab Rats.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2556-2792-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2556-2792-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Mnemonic Wall and Great Whale, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Great Whale.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Great Whale.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Mnemonic Wall and Great Whale tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

2239-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
2239-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Ardent Elementalist and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Ardent Elementalist, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1812-4659-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

5256-6323.easyPrerequisites: Jumbo Cactuar does not have summoning sickness.
5256-6323.description:
Declare Jumbo Cactuar as an attacker, triggering its ability, giving it +9999/+0 until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jumbo Cactuar, causing a player to mill their library.

880-3678-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3678-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1902-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
1902-1909-4486.description:
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.
1902-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

527-1792-5095.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.You control at least one additional creature without summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power five or greater.
527-1792-5095.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting any other creature you control without summoning sickness.
Cast Out of Time by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Out of Time enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Out of Time from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Out of Time trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

638-2093-2492.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Thrumming Stone triggers, revealing the top four cards of your library and putting them on the bottom of your library.
Resolve Bonus Round, copying all instants and sorceries cast after it this turn.
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Lapse of Certainty by paying {2}{W}, targeting that spell.
Bonus Round and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Bonus Round trigger, creating a copy of Lapse of Certainty, targeting the original Lapse of Certainty.
Resolve the copy of Lapse of Certainty, countering the original Lapse of Certainty and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 6, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Lapse of Certainty without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 6.

2438-2493-3235-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2438-2493-3235-3821.description:
During an opponent's combat step, activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Wake the Dead by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Wake the Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

2702-3658.description:
Archetype of Imagination causes your opponent' creatures to lose flying and be unable to gain flying.
Form of the Dragon prevents non-flying creatures from attacking you, and since none of your opponent' creatures can have flying, no creatures can attack you.

290-1651-2713-2797.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Retrofitter Foundry and an untapped Servo token, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's third ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing a tapped Servo token, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token with flying.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Retrofitter Foundry and an untapped Thopter token, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a tapped Thopter token, creating a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Retrofitter Foundry and an untapped Construct token, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {3}.
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

176-4509-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-4509-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature.
Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's trigger, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

2034-2506-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary, nontoken creature that has a creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
2034-2506-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nonlegendary, nontoken creature with a creature type named by Molten Echoes, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Echoes, creating a token copy of that creature with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
